name: Don't DNF Sigua 2025
information: Don't DNF Sigua 2025 es una competencia que se realizara a 30 minutos de la capital colonial de Honduras, siendo apoyada por la alcaldia municipal de Siguatepeque. Sera un evento abierto a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad. __________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Don't DNF Sigua 2025 is a competition that will take place 30 minutes from the colonial capital of Honduras, being supported by the municipal mayor of Siguatepeque. It will be an event open to competitors of any nationality.
